Come for an engaging story-time style lecture about the two halves of your brain and showcase your learning through an art project at the end! Space is limited to 15 participants, and tickets will be available at the Front Desk one hour before the event begins to secure a spot. Tickets and supplies are available on a first-come, first-served basis. We hope to see you there!

cases.refreshed: Do you have a 3D design or project but don't have a 3D printer and/or need help printing your design? If so, the West Valley Branch Library invites you to register for a two-hour appointment where a volunteer will help you print your project on the library's 3D printer. Appointments are scheduled on the first and third Saturdays of each month from 12:30-2:30. During the appointment, you will learn how to set up a file and print your design with guidance from one of our volunteers. Registered participants can choose a design from Thingiverse, Printables, or provide their own design. Designs must be in an. Stl file format and will be printed with PLA filament. Your. Stl file (or a link to your. Stl file on Thingiverse or Printables) must be submitted via email to wvmail@sjlibrary.org no later than the Thursday before your appointment. All prints are free and must meet the criteria listed below. Registration is required. Only 1 print per person and only 1 print per family/household per month. Also, please be aware that: Designs must be able to be loaded and saved on a Creality K1C 3D printer. All prints must take less than 1 hr 30 min (estimated 60 grams of filament). Prints are meant to be for personal use only and not for commercial purposes. No weapons or items that could be construed as a weapon will be accepted for print. Prints that are considered obscene or otherwise inappropriate for the library environment will be not accepted for print. The library's 3D printers must be used only for lawful purposes. All local, state, and federal laws must be followed. Accepted prints may not violate any third party's intellectual property, such as copyright, patent, or trademark. SJPL and library staff are not responsible for malfunctions or misprints. Library staff reserve the right to refuse any 3D print request.

events.title: Everyone Can Create: Beginning Stop Motion Animation

cases.refreshed: Children, teens, and tweens ages 8-14 are invited to this fun, in-person introduction to stop motion animation. 7-year-olds are welcome if accompanied by an older family member or caregiver. Participants will use the Stop Motion Studio app to make simple stop-motion animations. Stop motion animation can be a fun way for kids to express their ideas. Participants will have an opportunity to showcase their work at the end of the session. iPad devices will be provided to all participants to use during the class session. If you have your own iPad you would like to use, you can download the free Stop Motion app in advance. Free. Registration is recommended. Drop-ins are also welcome. Niños, preadolescentes y adolescentes de 8 a 14 años están invitados a esta divertida clase presencial de introducción a la animación de cuadro a cuadro (stop motion). Los niños de 7 años también son bienvenidos si están acompañados por un familiar mayor o un guardian. Los participantes usarán la aplicación Stop Motion Studio para crear animaciones sencillas en stop motion. La animación en stop motion puede ser una forma divertida para que los niños expresen sus ideas. Al final de la sesión, los participantes tendrán la oportunidad de mostrar su trabajo. Se proporcionarán dispositivos iPad a todos los participantes para usar durante la clase. Si tienes tu propio iPad y deseas usarlo, puedes descargar con anticipación la aplicación gratuita Stop Motion Studio. Gratis. Se recomienda registrarse. También se aceptan participantes sin registro previo. Esta clase se impartirá en inglés.

cases.refreshed: Looking for cute, fun, creative, and crafty wares? Check out the ARTrepreneur: Teen Craft Fair. All teens featured at this Fair have complete the ARTrepreneur entrepreneur program and are small business owners. Come support them and check out their incredible products. Cash and most payment apps accepted. No obligation to purchase. The Fair will be held during the TeenHQ Theater Production. Scheduled Vendors Fuzzy and Fluffy Fuzzy and Fluffy will be selling popular crocheted items, including loaf cats, octopi, and chickens. Keychain items like the mini octopus, mushroom pops, and mini chickens. These items are perfect as birthday or holiday gifts, or even room decor! We're looking forward to meeting you at our market! Green Apple Boutique Welcome to Green Apple Boutique! We are a small business located in the Bay Area and would love to have you as a part of our community! Our shop is currently focusing on the production of pins and jewelry but we plan to expand our inventory to cute stationary in the future! Lils Creations Lils Creations features handmade jewelry, customized stationery, beadable pens, unique keychains and charms. Designed with care, high-quality materials, and a touch of character-inspired charm, my items are crafted to offer thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts and accessories. Calderon & Co Calderon & Co Logo This endeavor is the amalgamation of a love for toys, 3D printing, and making money. The goal was to create a toy that could satisfy the urge to fidget or imagine new, forbearing the spontaneous horrors of a bored mind, without being a traditional, hyper-consumeristic toy that serves little purpose beyond draining your wallet. Three main problems were identified, alongside a single solution: affordable toys suck, they don't keep people still, and the CEO of C&C is very broke. The solution? A selection of 3D-printed fidget toys, tested profusely. What makes this selection unique is that people of all ages can come to the table and try the fidgets firsthand. Every effort is made to ensure product quality through careful selection of what gets sold, and by personally breaking them in so the initial rough texture is ameliorated as much as possible. Aydraw Art Ay Draw Logo Aydraw Art crafts & creations take the ease- and add some style. We create practical trinkets such as beautiful handmade keychains, pipe cleaner flowers, cards, cups, jewelry bowls, and so much more all to inspire your creative flame! For reasonable prices add some bling and express your individuality and creativity today! Two Tiny Potatoes Selling yarn-crafted items including star wands, keychains, flower hair clips, arm cuffs, coasters, and hand warmers. Forever Flowers Forever Flowers Logo Forever Flowers blends the beauty of bouquets with everlasting love from crocheting, which makes it the perfect gift for yourself or others to commemorate a moment with. Forever Flowers offers a wide range of crocheted products from flowers, coasters, plants and more that can be used for many different purposes. Yellowbunny Crochets Yellowbunny Crochets Logo Yellowbunny Crochets sells handmade crochet items, mostly plushies like animals and many different types of keychains. They usually sell a variety of crochet animals, from whales to bees to kirby to animated vegetables! Meghna's Nails Meghna's Nails Logo Meghna's nails sells handmade press on nails. Each set is carefully painted with gel Polish, beads, and gems. We bring affordable and convenient nails that are available in a variety of designs, shapes, and sizes straight to you! Great for elevating any outfit, Meghna's nails brings beauty in details! Learn about the ARTrepreneur program and how teens bring their small business dreams to life. Celebrating 10 years of SJPL TeenHQ

cases.refreshed: Are you comfortable riding in fair weather and want to continue riding even when it's dark, cold, or rainy? Are you wondering how to prepare for this year's El Niño? This class is for you! Learn how to stay warm, dry, and visible to enjoy bicycling and be safe even in wintry conditions. We'll cover clothing and gear recommendations, winter bike maintenance, safe riding tips, and more! You will also have the opportunity to ask questions and connect with other attendees. All participants will receive some reflective spoke covers to light up your ride after the sun goes down, as long as supplies last. Register This class run by Silicon Valley Bicycle Coalition (SVBC) in collaboration with Valley Transportation Authority (VTA) is provided to the public for at no cost with funding from 2016 Measure B courtesy of VTA.
